summary: A small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave Methocarbamol a low score for both liver and heart risks [M]. Warnings for this drug note that it may slow down the brain and spinal cord, so patients should be careful about combining it with alcohol or other substances that slow body functions [6]. It is also warned that safe use has not been proven regarding possible harmful effects on an unborn baby [6]. While Methocarbamol lists no problems of its own, similar medications carry strong warnings for blood problems, liver harm, or heart harm [3][4][5].
